metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: Like Clueless, this is an iconic, highly quotable teen comedy that defines its generation with sharp wit and memorable characters.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: A clever, fast-paced high school comedy that captures the witty, literary-inspired humor of 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: An incredibly uplifting and bright comedy with a charismatic lead, offering the same fashion-forward energy as Clueless.

metas.name: She's the Man
metas.description: Based on Shakespeare's Twelfth Night, this hilarious teen rom-com shares the brilliant modern-classic adaptation style of 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Directed by Shane Black, this slick, quick-witted buddy detective comedy is the perfect spiritual predecessor to The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: An incredibly fun, fast-paced mystery-comedy that balances hilarious ensemble dynamics with a genuinely engaging puzzle.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: Since you enjoy the Knives Out universe, this modern murder-mystery masterpiece delivers stellar humor, comfort, and cozy autumn vibes.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: The colorful, sun-drenched sequel to Knives Out delivers high-energy laughs, gorgeous settings, and a playful puzzle.

metas.name: See How They Run
metas.description: A breezy, stylish, and highly meta whodunit comedy that will appeal to fans of quirky mystery stories and theatrical humor.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A whimsical, romantic, and highly entertaining fantasy adventure that captures the magical charm of Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: The ultimate comfort fantasy movie, blending romance, swashbuckling action, and meta-comedy in a way that fans of D&D will adore.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: A perfect blend of action, campy horror, romance, and comedy, echoing the thrilling adventure vibes of Jumanji and Anaconda.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: A high-concept, highly energetic comedy adventure set inside a video game, perfect for fans of the modern Jumanji movies.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: A delightful throwback to romantic jungle adventure comedies, offering lighthearted fun, great star chemistry, and laugh-out-loud cameos.

metas.name: Love and Monsters
metas.description: A surprisingly heartfelt, visually inventive creature-feature adventure that is highly entertaining, light, and easy to watch.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: A brilliant, action-packed buddy-cop parody that matches the high-octane energy and sharp comedic timing of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Logan Lucky
metas.description: A breezy, incredibly fun 'hillbilly heist' comedy from Steven Soderbergh that features a fantastic ensemble cast having absolute blast.

metas.name: Ocean's Eleven
metas.description: The ultimate slick heist movie, filled with effortless charm, star-studded banter, and a relaxed, cool-as-ice atmosphere.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: A visually dazzling, fast-paced action-romance comedy that incorporates video game logic and a quirky sense of humor.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A beautifully animated, hilarious, and heartwarming sci-fi comedy about a dysfunctional family saving the world from a robot apocalypse.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: Matches the colorful, music-infused cosmic action and self-aware comedic tone of Thor: Ragnarok perfectly.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.description: An incredibly vibrant, fast, and feel-good superhero adventure with a stunning art style and a fantastic sense of humor.

metas.name: Zoolander
metas.description: An absurd, cartoonish, and endlessly quotable fashion industry satire that appeals to fans of Ace Ventura's wacky energy.

metas.name: Tropic Thunder
metas.description: A hilarious, chaotic, and action-packed satire of Hollywood that features standout comedic performances and non-stop laughs.

metas.name: Borat
metas.description: Featuring the same daring, cringe-comedy genius of Sacha Baron Cohen as seen in Brüno, but with even more cultural impact.

metas.name: Bridesmaids
metas.description: A laugh-out-loud funny, chaotic, and heartwarming female-led comedy that matches the R-rated humor of A Bad Moms Christmas.

metas.name: Booksmart
metas.description: A witty, fast-paced, and incredibly warm modern teen comedy about female friendship, packing great music and endless charm.

metas.name: We're the Millers
metas.description: A hilarious, chaotic road-trip comedy about a fake family smuggling contraband, full of high-energy laughs and great chemistry.

metas.name: Enola Holmes
metas.description: A bright, energetic, and lighthearted mystery adventure where the protagonist frequently breaks the fourth wall with charm.

metas.name: Clue
metas.description: The definitive slapstick ensemble mystery movie, filled with rapid-fire dialogue, physical comedy, and infinite rewatchability.

metas.name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
metas.description: A visually stunning, whimsical, and highly detailed caper that offers a delightfully quirky sense of humor and warmth.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: A beautiful, comforting romantic comedy with a sci-fi time-travel twist that focuses on family, love, and enjoying everyday life.

metas.name: Amélie
metas.description: A whimsical, gorgeous French romance about a quirky girl who decides to help the people around her, radiating comfort and joy.

metas.name: Shaun of the Dead
metas.description: The ultimate rom-com-zom, balancing genuinely thrilling moments with phenomenal British wit and cozy, comforting humor.

metas.name: Romy and Michele's High School Reunion
metas.description: A colorful, campy, and incredibly sweet 90s buddy comedy that celebrates female friendship and fabulous, questionable fashion.

metas.name: Crazy Rich Asians
metas.description: A lavish, extremely comforting romantic comedy filled with luxury, incredible food, family drama, and sparkling comedic relief.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: A stylized, high-octane action comedy with an eccentric ensemble cast and a highly entertaining web of intersecting plotlines.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: A fun, stylized, and self-aware spy action-adventure that feels like a comic book brought to life with incredible choreography.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A clever, cynical yet ultimately sweet sci-fi rom-com about two wedding guests stuck in a time loop together.

metas.name: Pitch Perfect
metas.description: An incredibly fun, music-centric comedy featuring great ensemble dynamics, sharp-tongued humor, and highly catchy vocal performances.
